description: Keep the JDK that runs and compiles the build on the latest GA release. Bytecode targets are not touched.

customManagers.description: Build JDK: .java-version (read by actions/setup-java via java-version-file)
Build JDK: Gradle toolchain version (java-compilation) in the version catalog

packageRules.description: Build JDK: follow every GA release (overrides workarounds:javaLTSVersions), bump all pins in one PR, never automerge
Other JDKs installed by actions/setup-java (compatibility matrices, toolchain pre-installs) mirror versions declared in the build and are changed by hand together with it
